title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Matthew 9: the paralyzed man forgiven, the calling of Matthew, the ruler's daughter and the plentiful harvest.

questions.text: What did Jesus say to the paralyzed man when he saw their faith?
questions.explanation: Jesus said to the paralytic: Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.

questions.text: What did some of the scribes say to themselves about him?
questions.explanation: Some of the scribes said to themselves: This man blasphemes.

answers.text: This man is a teacher of the law

questions.text: What did the paralyzed man do after Jesus told him to get up?
questions.explanation: Jesus told him to get up, take up his mat and go to his house, and he arose and departed to his house.

answers.text: He stayed lying on his bed
He arose and went to his house
He followed Jesus to the sea

questions.text: What was the man called whom Jesus called at the tax collection office?
questions.explanation: Jesus saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office and said to him: Follow me.

questions.text: Whom did Jesus say he came to call?
questions.explanation: Jesus said he came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

questions.text: When did Jesus say the friends of the bridegroom would fast?
questions.explanation: He said the days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast.

answers.text: When the Pharisees fast with them
When new wine is put in old skins
When the bridegroom is taken away

questions.text: Where does Jesus say new wine is put?
questions.explanation: People do not put new wine into old wine skins, but into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.

answers.text: Into the barns of the harvest

questions.text: How long had the woman who touched the fringe of his garment had a discharge of blood?
questions.explanation: A woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him and touched the fringe of his garment.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the girl in the ruler's house?
questions.explanation: He told them to make room, because the girl was not dead, but sleeping, and they ridiculed him.

answers.text: She will rise at the last day
Her faith has made her well
She is not dead, but sleeping

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the harvest and the laborers?
questions.explanation: He said the harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few, and told them to pray that laborers would be sent out.

answers.text: The harvest belongs to the Lord of hosts
The laborers are many, but the harvest is small
The harvest will come at the end of the age
The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few
